title: AARO told the WSJ the shutdown was an EMP test
summary: Robert Salas tells of AARO told the WSJ the shutdown was an EMP test, about 2025 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: so that they were able to tell Joel Sheckchman that this was some sort of EMP test.

plain: Robert Salas, a former US Air Force officer who says he saw nuclear missiles shut down during a UFO sighting in 1967, says that in 2025 AARO, the Pentagon office that now investigates UFO reports, gave Joel Schectman, a Wall Street Journal reporter, an explanation that the shutdown was some kind of EMP test, meaning a test of an electromagnetic pulse that can knock out electronics. Salas links this to Sean Kirkpatrick, a former head of that office, and disputes it, since it would explain away his account.
